text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Even though everyone... cheered me on 
so much...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Can I really make my dream come true... as 
I am now? To contribute to Tomakomai...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
choice_data_list:
Hold onto that feeling and you'll be just 
fine.
Let's start over together from here!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes! Dreams are seized through 
determination. And with this sheer grit!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I've tasted adversity like this plenty of 
times back in Tomakomai! I will definitely 
overcome it!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...They say if you leave Japanese rowan in 
a hearth for seven days, it turns into 
charcoal of the highest quality.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Without rushing, push forward. And 
then—make Tomakomai shine.
